title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Remoto
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Account Executive
description:
Location:  Remote

Type:  Full-time | Contractor

Compensation: R$7,500 + Commission


About DolFinContent:

DolFinContent is a fast-growing creative marketplace connecting brands with top graphic designers, social media experts, and influencers. Our mission is to help businesses scale their creative output globally by delivering social media management, influencer marketing, and graphic design services at scale.

We’re seeking an Account Executive to lead our sales pipeline, build partnerships, and drive DolFinContent toward becoming a multi-six-figure creative brand.


Responsibilities:

Lead generation & deal closing:  Manage inbound and outbound sales opportunities from internal sources and marketplace leads.

Sales ownership:  Handle leads forwarded by Eliott and convert them into active clients.

Marketplace growth:  Apply to and manage all major marketplace platforms to expand DolFinContent’s visibility.

Partnership development:  Build and maintain strategic relationships with agencies, creators, and brands.

Revenue management:  Drive $100,000+ in total revenue across graphic design, influencer marketing, and social media management.

Cross-department collaboration:  Work closely with operations, marketing, and creative teams to optimize client experience and retention.


Compensation:

Commission:  10% of profit per sale, paid monthly.

Growth Path:  Opportunity to advance into a Sales Director role with a hybrid base + commission structure as the team scales.


Ideal Candidate:

3+ years of experience in sales, partnerships, or business development, ideally in digital marketing, SaaS, or creative industries.

Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

Proven record of closing deals and achieving revenue targets.

Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work independently.

Passionate about creative services, influencer marketing, and digital content.


Compensation:  10% profit on sales | Performance-based growth

Goal:  $100,000+ in annual revenue across service lines

title: Analista de Customer Success - CS
description:
Objetivo do Cargo

Atuar como ponto focal de Sucesso do Cliente da Deepful, responsável pelo relacionamento, onboarding, suporte e engajamento de clientes nacionais e internacionais. Construir treinamentos na plataforma Deepful e garantir a melhor experiência de uso da plataforma, contribuindo para retenção e expansão de contas, além de propor melhorias nos processos.


Principais Atividades e Entregáveis

1. Gestão de Relacionamento com Clientes

  • Atuar como ponto de contato principal para clientes Deepful.
  • Realizar onboarding de novos clientes, conduzindo treinamentos sobre a plataforma Deepful.
  • Manter relacionamento contínuo, acompanhando uso, engajamento e satisfação dos clientes.

2. Entendimento e Solução de Demandas

  • Entender as necessidades dos clientes e traduzir essas demandas em soluções e sugestões de melhorias para os times internos.
  • Personalizar o atendimento conforme o perfil de cada cliente, garantindo alinhamento de expectativas.

3. Suporte Técnico e Operacional

  • Auxiliar clientes em dúvidas, problemas técnicos ou operacionais durante a utilização da plataforma.
  • Atuar preventivamente para evitar churn e resolver rapidamente eventuais reclamações.

4. Desenvolvimento e Implementação de Treinamentos

  • Criar, testar, revisar e ajustar  materiais e cenários de treinamento na plataforma Deepful.
  • Garantir que os treinamentos e conteúdos estejam alinhados aos objetivos dos clientes e às melhores práticas dos clientes.

5. Proatividade e Propostas de Novas Ações

  • Propor melhorias contínuas nos processos de atendimento, engajamento e retenção de clientes.
  • Sugerir e implementar iniciativas que aumentem a satisfação, retenção e expansão de contas.
  • Compartilhar feedbacks relevantes dos clientes para o time de produto e liderança.

6. Relatórios e Indicadores

  • Gerar relatórios de acompanhamento de uso, satisfação e resultados dos clientes.
  • Apresentar sugestões e planos de ação com base nos dados coletados.


Regime: CLT

Carga horária: 40 horas semanais (horário comercial)

Benefícios:

  • Vale alimentação Caju
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco
  • Possibilidade de trabalho remoto

title: Lead AI Engineer
description:
Lead AI Engineer (3 Positions)

Location: Brazil (Remote / Hybrid based on project needs)


Role Overview

We are seeking highly skilled Lead AI Engineers based in Brazil to design, develop, and deploy scalable AI and machine learning solutions across enterprise systems. The ideal candidates will have strong expertise in Generative AI , RAG architectures , LLMs , and hands-on experience with the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) AI ecosystem.

You will lead AI engineering initiatives, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and drive innovation in intelligent automation, personalization, and data-driven decision-making.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and development of scalable ML models , Generative AI , and RAG-based solutions.
  • Build end-to-end AI/ML pipelines using GCP tools: Vertex AI , Gemini , Vector Search , and Managed Notebooks.
  • Develop intelligent agents and orchestration using LangChain , LangGraph , Google ADK , and CrewAI .
  • Build, fine-tune, and deploy custom LLMs and multimodal AI models.
  • Own technical architecture, solution design, performance optimization, and deployment strategies.
  • Partner with data engineers, cloud teams, and product stakeholders to integrate AI at scale.
  • Implement MLOps best practices for versioning, monitoring, retraining, and governance.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to AI engineering standards and frameworks.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering , including leadership responsibilities.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Generative AI and RAG pipelines .
  • Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).
  • Deep expertise in the GCP AI/ML stack , including:
  • Vertex AI
  • Gemini
  • Vector Search
  • AI Studio / AI APIs
  • Strong experience with agent-oriented frameworks :
  • LangChain
  • LangGraph
  • CrewAI
  • Google ADK
  • Experience deploying ML models into production using CI/CD and MLOps .
  • Strong understanding of APIs, data engineering fundamentals, cloud-native deployment, and microservices.
  • Excellent communication and ability to lead technical discussions with global teams.


Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with multi-agent systems and advanced tool orchestration.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes , Docker , and cloud-native architectures.
  • Understanding of AI security, compliance, and responsible AI frameworks.
  • Experience working in global, distributed engineering teams.


Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.

title: QA Funcional "981998"
description:
Quem Somos


A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


Analisar requisitos funcionais e técnicos para identificar cenários de teste;

Criar, revisar e executar casos de teste manuais e automatizados;

Realizar testes funcionais, exploratórios, de regressão e aceitação;

Reportar e monitorar defeitos encontrados, garantindo sua correção;

Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento, produto e design;

Garantir a cobertura de testes e a qualidade das entregas;

Auxiliar na definição e melhoria contínua dos processos de QA;

Participar das cerimônias ágeis (daily meetings, planning, review e retrospective);

Elaborar relatórios de testes e evidências de validação;

Apoiar na automatização de testes, quando necessário.


O que você precisa ter


  • Experiência comprovada em QA funcional;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de testes manuais e gestão de defeitos (Azure DevOps);
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar possíveis impactos e riscos em mudanças;
  • Conhecimento em testes de API (Postman, SoapUI);
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe;

Descrição da Empresa A Le But é uma empresa especializada em marketing e branding estratégico para clínicas, consultórios e negócios da área da saúde estética. Unimos performance, posicionamento e criatividade para construir marcas desejadas — marcas que influenciam, vendem e permanecem.

Qualificações

  • Edição em capcut e captions: para editar vídeos que serão postados em reels.
  • Ser focado em alta performance.
  • Ter olhar criativo e que eleve a percepção de valor do doutor.

title: Data Analyst
description:
TapGoods


TapGoods is an exciting, fast-growing start-up that is revolutionizing how rental companies optimize and grow their businesses. We’re working to make it easy to rent. 


There are tens of thousands of businesses in the US that provide event, tool, audiovisual, and recreation rentals. This fragmented $722 billion global industry has not yet adopted modern systems and instead relies on pen & paper or cobbles together dated technology solutions. We’re building a solution that modernizes and dramatically improves the rental process for both businesses and their customers. 


Our product engineering team uses agile processes to continuously deliver incremental functionality on a weekly basis. We are constantly evolving, looking at every sprint as an opportunity to celebrate our success and learn how to improve. 


Data Analyst Role


We need a Data Analyst to join our team to fulfill our customers’ reporting needs. Our cloud platform provides analytics and reporting to our customers to help them manage their rental business. We’ve built a data warehouse and are moving our canned reports into embedded Power BI reports. 


This role would work closely with the product team and engineers to take our reporting to the next level. 


Responsibilities 


  • Use Power BI to create reports using our data warehouse 
  • Look for insights in our data that can provide value to our customers 
  • Maintain the Snowflake data warehouse dimensional model 
  • Be a part of our engineering team 
  • Able to work fully remote with adequate internet speeds, workspace, zoom capabilities (good mic, headset, etc.), and multiple monitors 


Requirements 


  • 1-3 years of experience with SQL 
  • Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools 
  • Experience with Power Query M 
  • Experience with Snowflake data warehouse 
  • Understanding data models for OLAP vs OLTP 
  • Experience with dimensional modeling/star schemas 
  • An unstoppable internal drive 
  • A great attitude and work ethic 
  • Solution oriented, self starter, and team player 
  • SaaS experience is a plus 


Our Culture


We are a nimble, fast-growing startup with a fully remote work environment. We have different backgrounds and life experiences that create a highly motivated, empowered and productive team. 


We are all committed to excellent work, whether it be one task or a big project - we believe in sticking things out until they are finished, and in communicating as quickly and effectively as possible when things get in the way of completing promised work. We are committed to improving the lives of our customers through our platform and our genuine care for them.

title: Gerente de recursos humanos
description:
Atuar como gestor nas áreas designadas em todas as questões relevantes, executando as melhores estratégias e serviços de RH para atrair, desenvolver, motivar e reter as melhores pessoas. Servir como extensão da área de Departamento Pessoal, treinamento e Recursos Humanos do Grupo e para garantir uma aplicação consistente de todos os Padrões e Princípios de RH.


Responsabilidade chave

· Manter um alto nível de comunicação com a gestão das áreas designadas e apoiar ativamente as iniciativas de negócios e necessidades de negócios para contribuir com o processo decisório de estruturação e desenvolvimento de suas equipes e para que o negócio alcance seus objetivos

·Conhecimento amplo em folha de pagamento, pois o escopo envolve validar cálculos de rescisões, férias etc

· Gerenciar várias contratações, especialmente para posições operacionais.

· Desenvolver e aprimorar todo o processo de admissão de colaboradores

· Gerenciar o departamento pessoal e garantir que as obrigações, relações sindicais, remuneração e benefícios para os funcionários das áreas designadas sejam entregues em tempo hábil.

· Implantar e melhorar os programas de melhoria contínua e rewards para garantir o cumprimento das metas com foco na eficiência dos processos

· Promover e gerenciar um os funcionários em todos os níveis, por meio de ações de motivação, coaching, treinamento e desenvolvimento para atrair e reter os melhores talentos

· Participar do processo de recrutamento para todas as áreas para garantir a qualidade do processo.

Habilidades e habilidades de conhecimento

· Experiente no trabalho e totalmente qualificado / treinado

· Amplo conhecimento teórico e prático combinado incl. políticas e práticas da empresa

· Forte competência com várias ferramentas, procedimentos, conhecimento de normas trabalhistas e folha de pagamento.

Requisito de educação e experiência / qualificações mínimas

  •  5 anos de experiência

title: Senior FullStack Developer (Java+React) [Portugal]
description:
This vacancy is for our Portuguese team and you will have to relocate to Portugal.


We’re launching a new partnership with a valued client in fintech, and we’re growing our team to support this exciting collaboration

Client is a financial sciences company, combining data analysis, invention, and rigorous inquiry to help solve the toughest challenges in investment management, insurance technology, securities, private equity, and venture capital.


Project Overview:

The platform is a portfolio analytics tool used by asset owners, asset managers, and advisors.

The platform applies the best expertise in research, data science, and technology to modernize the analytics experience for institutional investors, helping them embrace a quantitative approach to multi-asset portfolio risk and investment decision making.

The available tools help investors perform factor-based risk analysis to inform manager due diligence, investment evaluation, and portfolio construction.

The client's headquarters is in the USA

We are seeking an experienced, full-stack Software Engineer to help own the innovation, technical design, and development of the platform.

Technology Stack:

  • Cloud based, modern web application stack using Java, Typescript, React.js
  • Apollo GraphQL as an popular open-source ecosystem for building and managing GraphQL APIs
  • Service oriented architecture, infrastructure-as-code
  • Continuous development and deployment
  • Auto-scaling and robust search (Postgres, OpenSearch)
  • Cloud technologies (AWS)
  • Cloud monitoring (Datadog)
  • Test automation (Cypress)


Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience preferred building and delivering customer facing products
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline
  • 7+ years of Experience with Java development
  • 3+ years of Experience with modern front-end technologies: React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript**
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, test automation, DevOps and cloud technologies (AWS preferred)
  • Prior experience with systems design, building enterprise SaaS solutions, experience with user research, and product analytics are a major plus
  • Strong communication skills , keen attention to detail, readiness to challenge assumptions and obsession with building quality software


Responsibilities:

  • Create, design, build and deploy SaaS product end to end with an agile approach, from conceptualization, through rigorous testing, and partnering with client´s multi-functional teams to ensure an outstanding in-product UX
  • Conduct front-end web development using React, TypeScript, CSS, and other technologies
  • Perform API design and development in Java, using cloud, microservices, and caching
  • Become a domain expert and trusted advisor in the full-stack software engineering field
  • Contribute to the continuous learning approach of the team by bringing in new insights, welcoming them from others, and generating even stronger outcomes as a result
  • Provide hands-on coding support and perform code reviews to ensure quality standards
  • Communicate clearly about progress, challenges, and technical decisions


Let us know if this challenge is for you!

title: Technical Sourcing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote Technical Sourcing Specialist based in Latin America with 2+ years of experience and excellent English communication skills — both written and spoken.


You’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and connecting top technical talent — including software engineers, developers, and other IT professionals — through platforms like LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing channels.


At Velozient, we’re a fast-moving, growth-stage company that values smart, proactive people who love connecting with others and enjoy the challenge of finding the best talent. You’ll play a key role in building and nurturing a high-quality pipeline that drives our hiring success.


Responsibilities

  • Proactively source, identify, and engage technical candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, social media, referrals, and other creative sourcing channels.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future technical roles.
  • Partner closely with Recruiters and Resource Managers to deeply understand technical requirements and deliver high-quality leads.
  • Conduct initial outreach and screening conversations to assess technical fit, interest level, and alignment with open positions.
  • Develop targeted search strategies using advanced Boolean logic, filters, and data mining techniques.
  • Track sourcing activity and candidate engagement using internal systems and tools.
  • Stay up to date on market trends, technologies, and sourcing innovations to improve talent pipelines continuously.
  • Represent Velozient’s brand professionally and enthusiastically in all candidate interactions.
  • Support diversity sourcing initiatives and help drive inclusive hiring practices.



REQUIRED Experience:

  • Excellent English skills — both written and verbal.
  • Minimum of 1+ years of experience in candidate sourcing or talent acquisition, with a focus on technical roles (e.g., software engineering, IT, data, or product).
  • Proven experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools.
  • Strong understanding of Boolean search, technical keyword targeting, and sourcing best practices.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Preferred Experience:

  • University degree.
  • Prior experience sourcing for North American-based companies.
  • Experience in a growth-stage or entrepreneurial organization.



What YOU Get!

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let’s learn from them -be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), designated national holidays, three sick leave days, and one floating day annually

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Senior Software QA Engineer


Location: Brazil Fully Remote

Reports To: Head of QA/ Engineering Manager

Setup: Consultancy/PJ

Must Have: English Resume and Professional level of English Communication Skills


About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Sr QA Engineer with strong experience in both automated and manual testing. This role is critical to ensuring our products meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and user experience. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to design and execute test plans, build automated test suites, and champion quality across the entire software development lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Test Planning & Execution
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, and potential risks.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans and test cases covering functional, regression, integration, and performance scenarios.
  • Perform manual testing for exploratory, usability, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Test Automation
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites (UI, API, and regression).
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality feedback.
  • Monitor and maintain test results, ensuring failures are triaged quickly.
  • Defect Tracking & Reporting
  • Log, prioritize, and track defects using issue tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Azure Linear).
  • Partner with developers to reproduce, debug, and verify fixes.
  • Provide clear reporting on test coverage, pass/fail rates, and quality trends.
  • Quality Advocacy
  • Participate in design reviews, backlog grooming, and sprint planning to identify potential issues early.
  • Suggest process improvements to enhance efficiency and prevent defects.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a QA Engineer, Software Tester, or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in writing automated tests using frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar .
  • Experience testing APIs using tools like Postman , REST Assured, or similar.
  • Solid understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI).
  • Strong debugging and root cause analysis skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


Why Join Us

  • Work with a collaborative, high-performing engineering team that values quality at every step.
  • Opportunity to shape and improve our test automation strategy and quality processes.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and opportunities for career growth.

title: Analista de CRM – Consultor de Implementação HubSpot
description:
Se você entende tudo de HubSpot, esta vaga é para você!


Posição: Analista de CRM - Consultor de Implementação HubSpot

Local: Remoto (Brasil)

Modelo de Trabalho: Full-time (PJ)


Sobre a Hack Your Marketing e sobre a vaga:


A Hack Your Marketing (HYM) atua com soluções integradas de Growth Marketing e Revenue Operations (RevOps) para empresas de tecnologia, sempre com foco em performance, automação e escalabilidade.


Somos parceiros HubSpot no Brasil e um dos nossos diferenciais é a especialização em implementação e sustentação de HubSpot, plataforma que utilizamos para transformar operações de marketing, vendas e customer success. Estamos buscando um(a) Consultor de HubSpot para compor nosso time e apoiar a operação e evolução dos sistemas de CRM dos nossos clientes.


Responsabilidades:


  • Gestão e manutenção de contas HubSpot: Atualizar, configurar e monitorar os módulos de Hubspot, garantindo organização e integridade dos dados.


  • Suporte a implementações e integrações: Apoiar o time nas fases de implementação do HubSpot, realizando configurações, testes e validações operacionais.


  • Atualização e segmentação de bases de dados: Garantir que os dados dos contatos e empresas estejam atualizados, corretamente segmentados e organizados para uso em campanhas e relatórios.


  • Criação e manutenção de relatórios simples: Gerar dashboards e relatórios operacionais em HubSpot para apoiar a análise de performance.


  • Apoio na automação de processos: Criar e revisar automações (workflows) no HubSpot, com foco na melhoria da eficiência dos processos internos dos clientes.


  • Documentação de processos e configurações: Registrar procedimentos, fluxos e padrões de uso do HubSpot para garantir consistência e escalabilidade.


  • Atendimento ao cliente: Ser o principal ponto de contato entre a agência e cliente, conduzir reuniões, dar suporte a utilização do HubSpot via WhatsApp e videoconferência.


Requisitos:


  • Boa fluência em Excel: Habilidade para criar planilhas, análises simples e organizar dados estruturados.


  • Raciocínio lógico e atenção a detalhes: Capacidade de entender fluxos e processos de negócios e traduzi-los para estruturas dentro do CRM.


  • Organização e proatividade: Perfil analítico, curioso e com iniciativa para aprender e resolver problemas com autonomia.


  • Interesse por tecnologia e marketing: Vontade de se desenvolver na área de CRM, automação e processos de marketing e vendas B2B.


  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal: Clareza para documentar processos e interagir com diferentes áreas e clientes.


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência prévia com CRM (como HubSpot, Salesforce, RD Station, Pipedrive etc.)


  • Experiência prévia com serviços de consultoria


  • Familiaridade com o mercado SaaS ou com empresas de tecnologia B2B.


  • Noções básicas de automação de marketing, jornada do cliente e funil de vendas.


  • Conhecimento básico de ferramentas como Google Looker Studio, Notion ou ClickUp.


O que oferecemos:


  • Flexibilidade para trabalho remoto e autonomia no dia a dia.


  • Treinamentos e certificações em HubSpot.


  • Acompanhamento técnico e oportunidades reais de crescimento.


  • Ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e com forte cultura de aprendizado.


  • Contato direto com clientes SaaS em diferentes estágios de crescimento.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de sistemas
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento ágil, garantindo a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade, escaláveis e alinhadas às metas de negócio.

- Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de sistemas, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia de software, segurança da informação, automação e observabilidade.

- Atuar como facilitador entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, traduzindo necessidades estratégicas em soluções tecnológicas eficientes.

- Conduzir o planejamento e acompanhamento de projetos, assegurando prazos, custos, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e qualidade das entregas.

- Implementar padrões de governança técnica, versionamento, testes automatizados, CI/CD e monitoramento contínuo de performance.

- Apoiar o crescimento técnico do time por meio de mentorias, feedbacks estruturados e planos de desenvolvimento individual.

- Fomentar uma cultura de colaboração, aprendizado contínuo, inovação e melhoria constante nos processos de desenvolvimento.

- Participar ativamente de decisões estratégicas sobre tecnologias, ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento que impactem a arquitetura corporativa.

- Promover o uso racional de recursos em nuvem, garantindo eficiência operacional, segurança e sustentabilidade financeira.

- Atuar na mitigação de riscos técnicos e na resolução de incidentes críticos, com foco em análise de causa raiz e prevenção.


Requisitos e qualificações:

- Experiência comprovada em Engenharia de Software, Arquitetura de Sistemas e Liderança Técnica de equipes ágeis de alta performance.

- Domínio técnico em:

- Arquitetura de microserviços e integração de sistemas distribuídos

- Cloud Computing (preferencialmente AWS, Azure ou GCP)

- Banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais

- Mensageria e streaming de dados (ex: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ)

- APIs RESTful, GraphQL e boas práticas de versionamento

- Ferramentas de CI/CD, containers (Docker, Kubernetes) e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)

- Forte conhecimento em metodologias Agile/Scrum/Kanban, gestão de backlog e métricas de produtividade técnica (lead time, throughput, qualidade de código).

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de sistemas
description:

Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.

- Fomentar uma cultura de colaboração, aprendizado contínuo, inovação e melhoria constante nos processos de desenvolvimento.

- Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de atuar estrategicamente e operacionalmente quando necessário.

- Proatividade, curiosidade tecnológica e capacidade de inspirar e engajar pessoas em torno de objetivos comuns.

title: Consultor de Automação Inteligência
description:
A Practia é uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina, presente em 9 países. Somos especialistas em Transformação Digital e Hiperautomação e levamos inovação tecnológica para clientes no Brasil e no mundo. Estamos em constante crescimento e buscamos um profissional que queira crescer conosco atuando como Consultor de automação inteligente . Irá apoiar no plano de avaliação do modelo operativo dos centros de excelência (COE) de hiperautomação, com o foco em detalhamento normativo, definição de padronização e planejamento do uso otimizado das estruturas envolvidas.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar na definição de estratégias e modelos para implementação de automação inteligente.
  • Participar da criação de políticas, processos e padrões que sustentem a automação de forma segura e escalável.
  • Contribuir para o planejamento e execução de iniciativas de automação, garantindo alinhamento com objetivos do negócio.
  • Apoiar na elaboração de planos de integração e evolução tecnológica.
  • Colaborar com áreas de negócio e tecnologia para garantir eficiência e conformidade nas soluções.
  • Orientar stakeholders sobre boas práticas e uso de ferramentas de automação.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e consultiva em projetos de automação inteligente.

Pré requisitos

  • Experiência em análise e diagnóstico de processos de negócio.
  • Vivência em projetos de automação inteligente (RPA, IA).
  • Formação mínima Lean Six Sigma Green Belt.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação: Automation Anywhere, Power Platform (Microsoft), Python e similares.
  • Habilidade para comunicação clara e gestão de stakeholders.


Requisitos desejáveis

Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Desejável pós-graduação ou MBA em Automação de Processos, Gestão de Projetos ou Transformação Digital.

title: QA Ops – Especialista em Automação de Massas de Dados com IA
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

QA Ops – Foco em Automação de Massas de Dados com IA


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e aprimorar estruturas de automação de testes (funcionais e não funcionais)
  • Criar e evoluir soluções de automação de massa de dados utilizando SQL, Python e ferramentas ETL/ELT
  • Planejar e executar estratégias inteligentes de dados para testes
  • Desenvolver aceleradores, frameworks e agentes para geração de dados com IA
  • Planejar, elaborar e executar cenários de testes (incluindo Gherkin)
  • Garantir processos de QA dentro do modelo Shift Left
  • Criar dashboards e relatórios automatizados
  • Atuar na gestão de dados de teste (segregação, versionamento e espurgo seguro)
  • Abrir, gerenciar e acompanhar bugs
  • Colaborar com times de Produto, Design e Engenharia para elevar a qualidade das entregas
  • Apoiar o time de QA e conduzir apresentações de resultados

Habilidades Técnicas

  • Java
  • JMeter
  • Jira
  • Postman
  • Selenium
  • RestAssured
  • Robot Framework
  • Zephyr
  • QA com IA / AI for Test Automation
  • Testes ágeis e mocks
  • Boas práticas de QA
  • Geração de massa de dados
  • SQL e Python
  • ETL/ELT
  • CI/CD
  • Gestão de dados de teste

Metodologias

  • Agile & Waterfall
  • Scrum e Kanban

Diferenciais / Domínio de Negócio

  • Experiência em Digital Banking

title: Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil-based)
description:
About the Role

Mindhive builds AI-powered vision systems that transform industrial production. As we scale globally, reliability, observability, and rapid issue response are critical. The Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil) plays a central role in ensuring our systems remain healthy across LATAM and European time zones.

You will lead the Platform Operations function — the customer-adjacent, reliability-focused counterpart to our Platform Engineering team in New Zealand. Your team will ensure our deployed systems are monitored, stable, recoverable, and well-understood by the rest of the business.

This role focuses on:

  • monitoring, alert quality, and fast incident response
  • supporting on-premise and edge deployments
  • improving operational processes and tooling
  • follow-the-sun coverage across Brazil and Portugal
  • ensuring operational readiness for engineering-led upgrades

You will collaborate closely with the NZ-based Platform Engineering team, who drive deep engineering projects (Puppet 8 rollout, Python 3.13 upgrade, CDK migration, CI/CD consistency, platform hardening, test-rig reliability). Together, you will form Mindhive’s global reliability backbone.

This is a hands-on leadership role with high impact on customer experience, system uptime, and our ability to scale installations worldwide.


About You

You are a strong operational leader with deep hands-on technical skills. You thrive in live production environments, enjoy solving real-world system issues, and understand how to build reliable systems across time zones. You excel in:

  • structured incident response
  • observability and monitoring
  • improving operational processes
  • leading teams in distributed, multicultural environments
  • working close to customers to ensure uptime and stability

You care about technical quality, clarity, and people — and you bring a mindset focused on resilience, collaboration, and steady improvement.


Key Competencies

  • Operational Excellence - builds systems, processes, and behaviours that improve stability and reliability.
  • Leadership & Mentorship - develops engineers and coordinates distributed teams.
  • Systems Thinking - sees the interplay between cloud, edge hardware, software, people, and processes.
  • Collaboration - works closely and constructively with NZ Platform Engineering and cross-functional teams.
  • Calm Under Pressure - handles incidents and live issues with clarity and good judgement.
  • Continuous Improvement - always looking for ways to automate, simplify, and strengthen operations.


Key Responsibilities

Platform Operations Leadership

  • Lead and grow the Platform Operations team across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Build a high-performing follow-the-sun operational capability that supports both internal teams and customers.
  • Establish clear daily operational rhythms, including alert review, ticket management, and incident response.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Mentor engineers and technicians across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure communication is clear, predictable, and aligned with our values.
  • Build a team that is highly accountable, collaborative, and customer-focused.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Own the quality and accuracy of Datadog dashboards, alerts, service catalog, resource catalog, and operational visibility.
  • Reduce alert noise, improve signal quality, and ensure teams receive actionable information.
  • Develop and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.

Incident Response & Reliability

  • Oversee first-line and second-line incident response during LATAM and EU hours.
  • Ensure fast, structured triage for issues across cloud, on-premise, and edge deployments.
  • Maintain clear escalation paths and strong communication practices during incidents.
  • Partner with Implementation and Customer Success teams to resolve client-facing issues.

Collaboration with Platform Engineering (NZ)

  • Act as the operational counterpart to NZ Platform Engineering.
  • Ensure operational readiness for major engineering initiatives, such as:

-Puppet 8 migration

-Python 3.13 upgrade

-CDK migration

-CI/CD unification

-Platform hardening

-Test rig and E2E reliability improvements

  • Provide field feedback, operational insights, and rollout support for these improvements.

System Health & Operational Excellence

  • Monitor the health of live systems across sites and proactively identify stability risks.
  • Help drive improvements in:

-edge hardware reliability

-network stability

-server provisioning consistency

-observability for both cloud and on-prem components

  • Work with teams to reduce operational toil and automate repetitive tasks.


Required Skills & Experience

Leadership & Communication

  • Experience leading distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Excellent communication in English and Portuguese.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, implementation, and customer-facing teams.
  • Strong organisational skills with ability to manage competing priorities.

Technical

  • Strong background in DevOps, SRE, or Production Engineering environments.
  • Hands-on experience operating hybrid cloud + on-premise / edge systems.
  • Proficiency with:

-Datadog (or similar observability platforms)

-AWS (IAM, networking, security, monitoring)

-Containerization (Docker)

-Kubernetes / K3S

-IaC tools (AWS CDK ideal)

  • Solid programming skills in Python (TypeScript/JavaScript is a plus).
  • Understanding of security best practices (identity, access, endpoint, and network security).

Operational

  • Experience running incident response, on-call processes, or follow-the-sun operations.
  • Proven ability to write and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.
  • Experience supporting industrial, IoT, or hardware-integrated systems (ideal).


About Us

Mindhive Ltd is a fast-moving AI company using machine learning and computer vision to reimagine industrial systems. Our products run across cloud, on-premise, and edge deployments, bringing AI performance and reliability directly to the factory floor.

We care deeply about people, quality, and impact. We work collaboratively, iterate quickly, and tackle meaningful, complex problems.

Mindhive is a New Zealand Hi-Tech Awards winner, recognised for innovation and impact in software, AI, and advanced manufacturing.


Work Environment & Flexibility

We support hybrid and remote work, with our people distributed across Brazil, Portugal, Italy, Japan and New Zealand. We trust each other to deliver results in ways that suit our lives while maximising our collective impact. We move quickly, adapt fast, and support each other through the ups and downs that come with building something new and meaningful.


Our values

  • Relentless Curiosity - we explore deeply, question assumptions, and seek better ways.
  • Authentic Humanity - we support and care for people first.
  • Inclusive Connection - we collaborate openly and build strong relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Determination to Deliver - we strive to do the right thing, consistently and with purpose.

title: Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil-based)
description:
About the Role

Mindhive builds AI-powered vision systems that transform industrial production. As we scale globally, reliability, observability, and rapid issue response are critical. The Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil) plays a central role in ensuring our systems remain healthy across LATAM and European time zones.

You will lead the Platform Operations function — the customer-adjacent, reliability-focused counterpart to our Platform Engineering team in New Zealand. Your team will ensure our deployed systems are monitored, stable, recoverable, and well-understood by the rest of the business.

This role focuses on:

  • monitoring, alert quality, and fast incident response
  • supporting on-premise and edge deployments
  • improving operational processes and tooling
  • follow-the-sun coverage across Brazil and Portugal
  • ensuring operational readiness for engineering-led upgrades

You will collaborate closely with the NZ-based Platform Engineering team, who drive deep engineering projects (Puppet 8 rollout, Python 3.13 upgrade, CDK migration, CI/CD consistency, platform hardening, test-rig reliability). Together, you will form Mindhive’s global reliability backbone.

This is a hands-on leadership role with high impact on customer experience, system uptime, and our ability to scale installations worldwide.


About You

You are a strong operational leader with deep hands-on technical skills. You thrive in live production environments, enjoy solving real-world system issues, and understand how to build reliable systems across time zones. You excel in:

  • structured incident response
  • observability and monitoring
  • improving operational processes
  • leading teams in distributed, multicultural environments
  • working close to customers to ensure uptime and stability

You care about technical quality, clarity, and people — and you bring a mindset focused on resilience, collaboration, and steady improvement.

  • Operational Excellence - builds systems, processes, and behaviours that improve stability and reliability.
  • Leadership & Mentorship - develops engineers and coordinates distributed teams.
  • Systems Thinking - sees the interplay between cloud, edge hardware, software, people, and processes.
  • Collaboration - works closely and constructively with NZ Platform Engineering and cross-functional teams.
  • Calm Under Pressure - handles incidents and live issues with clarity and good judgement.
  • Continuous Improvement - always looking for ways to automate, simplify, and strengthen operations.

Platform Operations Leadership

  • Lead and grow the Platform Operations team across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Build a high-performing follow-the-sun operational capability that supports both internal teams and customers.
  • Establish clear daily operational rhythms, including alert review, ticket management, and incident response.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Mentor engineers and technicians across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure communication is clear, predictable, and aligned with our values.
  • Build a team that is highly accountable, collaborative, and customer-focused.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Own the quality and accuracy of Datadog dashboards, alerts, service catalog, resource catalog, and operational visibility.
  • Reduce alert noise, improve signal quality, and ensure teams receive actionable information.
  • Develop and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.

Incident Response & Reliability

  • Oversee first-line and second-line incident response during LATAM and EU hours.
  • Ensure fast, structured triage for issues across cloud, on-premise, and edge deployments.
  • Maintain clear escalation paths and strong communication practices during incidents.
  • Partner with Implementation and Customer Success teams to resolve client-facing issues.

  • Act as the operational counterpart to NZ Platform Engineering.
  • Ensure operational readiness for major engineering initiatives, such as:

-Puppet 8 migration

-Python 3.13 upgrade

-CDK migration

-CI/CD unification

-Platform hardening

-Test rig and E2E reliability improvements

  • Provide field feedback, operational insights, and rollout support for these improvements.

  • Monitor the health of live systems across sites and proactively identify stability risks.
  • Help drive improvements in:

-edge hardware reliability

-network stability

-server provisioning consistency

-observability for both cloud and on-prem components

  • Work with teams to reduce operational toil and automate repetitive tasks.

title: Limpador - Colaboração Paga (Consultoria Técnica)
description:
Título: Especialista em Limpeza | Colaboração Paga (Consultoria Técnica)


Descrição:

A mybest Brasil está em busca de um(a) profissional com experiência prática em limpeza doméstica para colaborar como consultor(a) especialista em nossos guias de compra e artigos sobre produtos e ferramentas para o lar.


Entre os temas que abordamos estão limpadores para azulejos e rejuntes, repelentes de pragas, aspiradores de pó, máquinas de lavar e outros produtos usados no dia a dia da casa .


Como funciona a colaboração:

  • Questionário: responder um breve formulário online indicando os critérios mais importantes para escolher cada tipo de produto (efetividade, segurança, facilidade de uso, durabilidade, custo-benefício, o que evitar etc.).
  • Revisão do artigo: revisar o rascunho antes da publicação para garantir precisão técnica e clareza nas recomendações.
  • Crédito: seu nome e mini bio aparecerão como especialista no artigo. Se tiver site ou blog profissional , incluímos o link no perfil (excelente oportunidade para aumentar sua autoridade e visibilidade).


Condições da colaboração:

  • Pagamento: R$ 350 por artigo (questionário + revisão).
  • Pagamento realizado até o dia 20 do mês seguinte à entrega.
  • Colaboração pontual, 100% remota.

title: Quality Control Lead
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a structured, strict, and technically-minded Head of Quality Assurance who will build and lead one of the most critical operational units in the company.

Scope of responsibility:

  • Management of a team of 30+ remote assistants
  • Quality control of 5,000+ job applications/month (scaling to 10,000+)
  • Direct reporting to the CEO


Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • 30 assistants submit job applications on behalf of clients
  • Quality is inconsistent—there is no systematic control
  • Many manual review processes → we need automation
  • No structured onboarding for new assistants
  • No clear KPIs or performance-based motivation


What must be built:

Audit the current team

Hire additional assistants

Build a full Quality Assurance system from scratch

Automate quality checks in collaboration with engineering

Implement onboarding, training, and control processes


Key Responsibilities

Build a Quality Assurance system (30%)

First 2 weeks:

  • Audit current assistants
  • Evaluate work quality (accuracy, speed, compliance)
  • Decide who stays, who leaves
  • Create quality criteria and checklists

Ongoing:

  • Implement regular quality audits and spot-checks
  • Establish KPIs (quality, speed, customer satisfaction)
  • Track quality metrics per assistant
  • Identify repeating errors and remove root causes
  • Review difficult cases with the team

Hiring & Onboarding (25%)

Hiring:

  • Design the hiring funnel (screening → test task → interview)
  • Hire new assistants within first 1–2 months
  • Maintain a candidate pipeline (no current churn, but may appear)

Onboarding & training:

  • Build a structured onboarding program (1–2 weeks)
  • Teach systems, standards, and workflows
  • Certify assistants before they start working with clients
  • Create training materials, videos, guides

Automation & Technology (20%)

Work with engineering team:

  • Identify which checks can be automated
  • Create clear requirements and tasks for developers
  • Test and launch automation tools
  • Utilize AI and scripts for monitoring

Automation examples:

  • Automatic validation of application fields
  • Duplicate application detection
  • Performance dashboards and speed tracking
  • Quality alert system
  • Real-time monitoring tools

Team Management (15%)

  • Workload distribution among assistants
  • KPI tracking and performance reviews
  • Escalation handling and issue resolution
  • Motivation and team culture development

People development:

  • Selective 1:1s
  • Coaching low performers
  • Promote top performers into team leads
  • Create internal career paths

Continuous improvement (10%)

  • Identify bottlenecks and improve processes
  • Implement best practices and standardization
  • Maintain operations documentation
  • Work with client complaints, root cause elimination

Requirements

Must-Have:

2+ years managing operational teams

  • Experience managing 20+ employees
  • Built processes from scratch
  • Preferably BPO/outsourcing/call center/EdTech

Strong systems thinking and discipline

  • SOPs, checklists, regulations, compliance
  • Precision and attention to detail
  • Ability to make difficult decisions (terminations, corrective action)

Technical competency

  • Understanding of automation & quality monitoring
  • Ability to write clear requirements for developers
  • Experience with CRM, monitoring dashboards, etc.
  • Nice-to-have: SQL basics, API logic, scripting

Analytical approach

  • Metrics: quality %, speed, productivity, error rate
  • KPI systems and reporting
  • Data-driven decision-making

Experience in hiring & onboarding


Strong Plus:

BPO/outsourcing experience (data entry, support, back office)

Quality automation experience

Technical degree (engineering / CS / math)

Six Sigma/Lean/Kaizen knowledge

Experience scaling teams from 10 → 50+

QA/Quality Management certifications

Experience with distributed remote teams

title: Desenvolvedor Python
description:
Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Estamos com uma oportunidade para o nosso time corporativo para: Desenvolvedor Python.


Experiência Profissional


Requisitos


  • Experiência sólida com Python e Django.
  • Forte conhecimento em Django Rest Framework (DRF).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL e MySQL).
  • Boas práticas de arquitetura (DDD, Clean Architecture, SOLID).
  • Experiência com criação e consumo de APIs REST.
  • Conhecimento em Docker, containers e ambientes Linux.
  • Experiência com versionamento em Git.
  • Experiência com testes unitários
  • Conhecimento em segurança de APIs e autenticação (JWT, OAuth2).
  • Experiência com debugging, otimização de queries e performance.


Diferencial


  • Experiência com FastAPI ou Flask.
  • Conhecimento de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS).
  • Experiência com AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (GitLab, Jenkins, Azure DevOps).
  • Experiência com Redis, Celery e cache distribuído.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microsserviços.
  • Experiência em GraphQL.


Formação Acadêmica


  • Graduação completa.


Modelo de trabalho:


  • Remoto: Home office - 100%.

title: Performance Marketing Director
description:
Performance Marketing Director Part-Time

Empresa: Mirantis

A Mirantis está em busca de um Performance Marketing Director (Part-Time) altamente analítico, orientado por dados e focado em resultados para liderar nossa estratégia de mídia paga em múltiplos canais. Este papel é ideal para profissionais que dominam números, entendem funis de conversão e conseguem gerar crescimento mensurável com recursos otimizados.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar estratégias de mídia paga (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads)
  • Gerenciar orçamentos, prever resultados e garantir execução com foco em ROAS
  • Conduzir testes A/B, otimização de funil, melhorias em landing pages e segmentação de audiência
  • Criar e acompanhar dashboards de CPA, CTR, ROAS, CAC, LTV e análises de cohort
  • Colaborar com as equipes de produto, conteúdo e analytics para alinhar prioridades de crescimento
  • Identificar novas oportunidades de expansão e escalar campanhas de alto desempenho

Requisitos:

  • 5+ anos de experiência em performance marketing ou liderança em mídia paga
  • Forte domínio de Google Ads e Meta Ads (obrigatório)
  • Histórico comprovado de gestão de orçamento, escala de campanhas e melhoria de ROAS
  • Capacidade de interpretar dados, criar dashboards e tomar decisões rápidas baseadas em insights
  • Experiência com modelos de atribuição, automação e testes de performance
  • Capaz de trabalhar remotamente, em modelo part-time e com diferentes fusos horários

Benefícios:

  • Horário flexível (part-time)
  • Oportunidade de liderar a estratégia de performance em uma empresa digital-first
  • Ambiente remoto e colaborativo
  • Remuneração competitiva proporcional ao modelo part-time

title: Consultor SAP PS (AMS)
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidade:

  • Consultor(a) PS para compor o time de AMS da NTT DATA.


Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento no processo de criação de gestão de PEP
  • Conhecimento em orçamento de PEP's e seu gerenciamento
  • Definição de perfil de PEP's de investimento e despesas
  • Configuração do módulo PS
  • Desenvolvimento e análises de programa "Z's
  • Controle de estoque por PEP
  • Boas relações interpessoais
  • Inglês desejável



Garantimos que nossos funcionários sejam bem tratados, oferecendo pacotes de remuneração específicos para cada país, programas de reconhecimento e benefícios de prevenção. Dessa forma, incentivamos nossos colaboradores a terem o melhor desempenho e a comemorarem suas conquistas.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Inviting Senior Editors of EI Compendex Journals
description:
We are a seasoned academic service team dedicated to advancing international scholarly exchange and collaboration. To better support researchers worldwide in disseminating their work, we are now seeking experienced professionals like you—with a background as an editor or special issue organizer for EI Compendex-indexed journals —to join our expert team and contribute to elevating the quality and impact of academic papers.


We Are Looking For Candidates with the Following Profile:

  • A strong academic research background and a respected reputation in your field.
  • Must possess one of the following senior-level experiences:
  • Must currently be organizing and guest-editing a Special Issue for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.
  • Must currently be serving as an editor, associate editor, or editorial board member for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.


Your Role Will Include (Clear Academic Support Services):

  • Academic Review & Deep Polishing: Evaluate manuscripts for scientific rigor, logic, and originality, while refining academic expression, flow, and terminology to meet international publication standards.
  • Professional Translation & Grammar Polishing: Accurately translate Chinese research papers into natural, fluent academic English, ensuring correctness in grammar, spelling, and sentence structure.
  • Figure Optimization: Ensure all figures, charts, and images in the manuscript comply with the technical requirements of target journals, including but not limited to: format, layout, resolution (DPI), color mode, and file size.
  • Cover Letter Drafting: Assist authors in concisely summarizing the manuscript’s core strengths, innovations, and academic value in a compelling cover letter , enhancing its initial impression on journal editors.
  • Submission Assistance: Based on the article’s specific content, academic quality, and research field, recommend suitable journals indexed in the EI Compendex database for the author’s reference and selection.


Our Commitment and Emphasis (Core Compliance):

  • Full Compliance: All services we provide are strictly for “academic support” and absolutely do not involve any form of ghostwriting, data fabrication, or plagiarism . Your work will focus solely on improving the quality of the author’s original manuscript, with all final decisions remaining with the author.
  • No Acceptance Guarantee: We do not and cannot guarantee that any manuscript will be accepted. The final decision on publication rests entirely with the journal’s editors and peer-review process. Submission assistance is solely a recommendation based on content and does not imply any outcome.
  • Respect for Academic Integrity: We strictly adhere to publishing ethics standards (e.g., COPE guidelines). Our services are designed to help authors overcome language, presentation, and technical barriers, not to replace their core research work.


By Joining Us, You Will Receive:

  • Competitive remuneration and flexible working hours that fully respect your academic schedule.
  • Opportunities to engage with cutting-edge research and exchange ideas with outstanding global scholars.
  • The professional satisfaction of contributing to clearer, more standardized, and influential scientific communication.

If our mission resonates with you, and you wish to leverage your senior experience to help more scholars share their work globally, we sincerely invite you to get in touch.


We look forward to partnering with you in upholding the beacon of academic excellence!

title: Auxiliar financeiro
description:
Descrição da Empresa: Somos a Dreams Nutrition, criamos produtos inovadores no mercado digital e estamos sempre otimizando nossas ações.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de um Auxiliar Financeiro para integrar a equipe da Dreams Nutrition. As responsabilidades incluem a organização e análise de documentos financeiros, elaboração de relatórios financeiros, suporte nas atividades contábeis e colaboração com a equipe para facilitar processos financeiros. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e será realizado remotamente.

Qualificações

  • Controle e relatórios financeiros: Capacidade de preparar, analisar e organizar demonstrações financeiras e relatórios financeiros.
  • Habilidades analíticas e financeiras: Conhecimento em análises financeiras e noções financeiras básicas para apoiar decisões estratégicas.
  • Comunicação: Competências efetivas na comunicação verbal e escrita para garantir interação clara com a equipe e partes interessadas.
  • Será um diferencial ter formação na área financeira, conhecimento em sistemas de gestão financeira e experiência prévia em funções administrativas ou contábeis.

title: Senior Software Engineer (JavaScript / RoR)
description:
Senior Software Engineer (JavaScript / RoR)We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience using Ruby on Rails to join as a core member of our U.S. client's tight-knit, experienced engineering team. In this role, you will play a leadership role as well as actively contribute to strategizing and building at the feature level rather than just focusing on outputs.

Our client is a venture capital-backed health tech company transforming the industry's coding practices by creating a marketplace that connects healthcare companies with over 4,000 certified coding specialists. The client is focused on expanding quickly its product, engineering, and design teams with passionate builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment to support its rapid growth.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering and product stakeholders to define, design, and build new features and integrations
  • Advance software platform capabilities using Ruby on Rails
  • Develop and support third-party integrations with B2B healthcare systems
  • Provide work estimates for bug fixes, enhancements, and features
  • Deliver high-quality, well-documented code with velocity
  • Mentor junior engineers and aid the engineering team with troubleshooting
  • Write and execute unit tests
  • Promote development best practices following team standards with an eye towards innovation and opportunities to scale
  • Work independently with minimal need for oversight and a bias towards action as well as display a willingness to ask questions when needed to remain efficient
  • Become energized by tackling new challenges and eagerly give and receive feedback from colleagues


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience using Ruby on Rails, including version 7+, with a strong background in JavaScript and frameworks (preferably Stimulus)
  • Experience taking the lead on complete features, appropriate to your level, and showing initiative to solve ambiguous problems
  • Experience creating and consuming APIs
  • Knowledge of relational / non-relational database systems
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience in healthcare, healthtech industry, or growth stage startups
  • Experience with Stimulus, Turbo, Tailwind, Sidekiq, or Heroku Shield


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Salesforce Developer | UI Focused
description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Salesforce UI Developer to help build a next-generation compliance and reporting platform used in the clean energy and infrastructure space.

You’ll be part of a dedicated Salesforce product engineering team that’s building scalable, data-driven applications entirely on Salesforce — with Lightning Web Components (LWC) powering a modern, dynamic user experience.

This is a hands-on engineering role , ideal for developers who live at the intersection of front-end design and Salesforce architecture — people who write clean, modular code and care deeply about performance, usability, and aesthetics.


What You’ll Do
  • Design and develop Lightning Web Components (LWCs) and Aura components for custom pages, dashboards, and portals.
  • Build and customize Experience Cloud sites for customers, partners, and internal teams — working with themes, branding sets, and custom navigation.
  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to bring mockups and design systems to life while maintaining Lightning Design System (SLDS) standards.
  • Integrate LWCs with Apex controllers and REST APIs , ensuring efficient data flow between the front-end and backend systems.
  • Implement performance optimizations such as caching, pagination, and lazy loading for large datasets.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing (Jest, Apex), and CI/CD pipelines to ensure high-quality, maintainable releases.
  • Contribute to front-end architecture decisions, documentation standards, and reusable component libraries.


What We’re Looking For
  • 5+ years of Salesforce development experience , including at least 2 years focused on Lightning Web Components (LWC) .
  • Proven experience building and customizing Experience Cloud (Community Cloud) portals.
  • Strong understanding of Apex, Salesforce DX, and data model design .
  • Solid front-end fundamentals: JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 , and ideally TypeScript .
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST APIs or Platform Events .
  • Familiarity with Git-based DevOps tools such as Copado, Gearset, or Bitbucket Pipelines.
  • Certifications: Salesforce Platform Developer I and JavaScript Developer I (required). Platform Developer II or Experience Cloud Consultant are strong pluses.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, design, and product teams.


Nice to Have
  • Background in UI/UX or front-end design (e.g., Figma, SLDS customization).
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems or reusable component libraries .
  • Knowledge of CI/CD automation , unit testing , and code quality frameworks

﻿ .

Why This Role
  • You’ll work with a team that treats Salesforce as a true engineering platform , not just a configuration tool. This is a chance to own the front-end experience of a product used across major infrastructure and renewable energy projects, where performance, polish, and usability truly matter.

This is a hands-on engineering role , ideal for developers who live at the intersection of front-end design and Salesforce architecture — people who write clean, modular code and care deeply about performance, usability, and aesthetics.


What You’ll Do
  • Design and develop Lightning Web Components (LWCs) and Aura components for custom pages, dashboards, and portals.
  • Build and customize Experience Cloud sites for customers, partners, and internal teams — working with themes, branding sets, and custom navigation.
  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to bring mockups and design systems to life while maintaining Lightning Design System (SLDS) standards.
  • Integrate LWCs with Apex controllers and REST APIs , ensuring efficient data flow between the front-end and backend systems.
  • Implement performance optimizations such as caching, pagination, and lazy loading for large datasets.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing (Jest, Apex), and CI/CD pipelines to ensure high-quality, maintainable releases.
  • Contribute to front-end architecture decisions, documentation standards, and reusable component libraries.


What We’re Looking For
  • 5+ years of Salesforce development experience , including at least 2 years focused on Lightning Web Components (LWC) .
  • Proven experience building and customizing Experience Cloud (Community Cloud) portals.
  • Strong understanding of Apex, Salesforce DX, and data model design .
  • Solid front-end fundamentals: JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 , and ideally TypeScript .
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST APIs or Platform Events .
  • Familiarity with Git-based DevOps tools such as Copado, Gearset, or Bitbucket Pipelines.
  • Certifications: Salesforce Platform Developer I and JavaScript Developer I (required). Platform Developer II or Experience Cloud Consultant are strong pluses.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, design, and product teams.


Nice to Have
  • Background in UI/UX or front-end design (e.g., Figma, SLDS customization).
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems or reusable component libraries .
  • Knowledge of CI/CD automation , unit testing , and code quality frameworks

﻿ .

Why This Role
  • You’ll work with a team that treats Salesforce as a true engineering platform , not just a configuration tool. This is a chance to own the front-end experience of a product used across major infrastructure and renewable energy projects, where performance, polish, and usability truly matter.

description:
Descrição da Vaga

A SB Alimentos é especializada em cortes prontos de bovino, suíno e frango (iscas, cubos, bifes), além de linguiças defumadas e frescas, bacon, carne moída e carne seca. Nosso frigorífico é reconhecido pela qualidade, pontualidade e atendimento.

Somos uma empresa familiar há mais de 20 anos no mercado e em crescimento contínuo. Buscamos profissionais que saibam se comunicar, priorizar e sugerir soluções integradamente com a nossa equipe.

O cargo em questão possui foco em faturamento. Indicações e estabilidade nas empresas antecessoras, dentro ou fora do setor, serão levados em consideração.



Responsabilidades

  • Emissão e cancelamento de nota fiscal, bem como carta de correção.
  • Elaboração de romaneio de carga e roteirização.
  • Atividades pertinentes ao cargo.



Requisitos

  • Domínio básico de Excel e Office.
  • Comunicação clara, proatividade e organização.
  • Histórico profissional estável (tempo mínimo em empregos anteriores).
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial em Jundiaí – SP.



Benefícios

  • Refeitório no local
  • Convênio médico
  • Vale‑transporte
  • Vale‑cesta


Salário: R$ 2.500,00 – R$ 3.000,00/mês

Horário: segunda a quinta das 9h às 19h e sexta das 9h às 18h.

title: Enterprise Support Engineer
description:
About HotMic


HotMic builds AI-powered video creation workflows that help creators and media teams produce high-quality content faster and more efficiently. We operate our own platform and also work closely with large enterprise customers to deliver custom, high-impact solutions.



Role Overview


We are hiring a Senior Enterprise Support Engineer to work directly with one major enterprise customer. This is a hands-on role involving both full-stack JavaScript development and customer-facing support. You will gather requirements, develop and ship customer-specific features, resolve issues, and keep the customer updated through calls and messages. You’ll also participate in our regular engineering sprints alongside other developers and product staff.



Responsibilities


  • Develop and deliver features tailored to a large enterprise customer.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Communicate directly with the customer via calls and messages.
  • Work within engineering sprints and coordinate with internal teams.
  • Maintain clear, fluent English communication.



Requirements


  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Senior-level full-stack JavaScript experience.
  • Experience working in structured team sprints.
  • Background working with enterprise customers or complex implementations.
  • Comfortable in a mixed engineering + support role.
  • Strong teamwork and ability to work independently.

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: Contract (PJ)


About Smart IT Frame:

At Smart IT Frame, we connect top talent with leading organizations across the USA and LATAM. With over a decade of staffing excellence, we specialize in IT, healthcare, and professional roles, empowering both clients and candidates to grow together.


Key Responsibilities:

• We are seeking a Workday Certified Project Manager / Business Analyst to support production support and enhancement initiatives.

• Lead and coordinate release activities, Agile ceremonies, and sprint planning.

• Prepare project presentations, resource plans, and schedules.

• Gather, document, and validate business requirements and functional designs.

• Perform data analysis and translate findings into actionable insights.

• Act as a Workday Configuration SME to support production issues and enhancements.

• Review test cases, support UAT, and maintain a knowledge/response catalog.

• Work independently on CCB and Studio integrations in Workday HCM space , including payroll and end-to-end support.
